items.item_text: Experience working at public colleges and universities, especially with senior administrators.

Experience working with low-income communities and immigrants, preferably immigrant youth/young adults and experience working in a multicultural environment and skills to communicate, interact, and work with diverse constituencies, particularly in student services organizations.

The UC Immigration Legal Services Center (UCIMM) is a college-based, immigration legal services program headquartered at the UC Davis School of Law with staff present and providing services at nine UC campuses. We provide advice and counsel and direct legal representation in immigration matters, and engage in education and outreach, advocacy, and other strategic initiatives. We offer free services to enrolled undocumented UC students and students from mixed status families; family members of enrolled UC students; and UC staff, at nine UC campuses.

Under the supervision of the Executive Director, the Legal Services Director will serve as a member of UCIMM’s senior leadership team. This position is responsible for the overall management of immigration legal services, including overseeing the provision of high-quality immigration legal services, program quality, staff performance, and support for the legal team. This position is also responsible for strategic planning as well as program design and implementation.
Familiarity with UC policies and procedures, motions practice, immigration, administrative appeals, and federal court practice.
